text:
This looks like early 2012. The unemployment rate of 8.3% matches February 2012, and the 10-year yield of 1.94% and the fed funds rate of 0.10% fit that period too.

Other figures also line up with February 2012:
- US large-cap equity returned +15.2% over 3 months, consistent with the rally from October 2011 to February 2012.
- Headline CPI was 2.93% year over year, close to the February 2012 reading of 2.9%.
- Payrolls averaged about 200k over 3 months.
- The VIX was about 18.
- The 20y+ Treasury 12-month return of +31.7% fits the 2011 rally.

I settled on February 2012 over January 2012, when unemployment was 8.3% and CPI was 3.0%. The VIX fell 9.84 points over 3 months, from about 28 in November, which also fits February.
